requiredChanges: Replace fallback only on removal with fallback only when the prior control is no longer eligible under the frozen per-surface policy; explicitly preserve a disabled-but-focusable control when030 permits it, and apply the declared fallback when it does not.

Accord remains an editorial working name pending user preference, not technical unanimity or a release gate.
